# ceyonai

> ceyonai is an AI video editor for short-form creators that auto-generates accurate captions in Tamil, Thanglish, and other Indic languages, then edits the whole reel — auto-zoom, silence & filler removal, retake cutting, B-roll, translation — and exports up to 4K. Built for Indian creators. Free plan available; paid access from a ₹59 day pass.

## What ceyonai does
- Auto-captions video in Tamil, Thanglish (Tamil–English code-mix), Hindi, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam and more Indic languages
- 12 animated caption styles (karaoke, highlight, pop, glow and more), burned into the export
- Silence removal, filler-word removal ("uh/um/aa"), and duplicate/retake cutting
- Auto-zoom, B-roll overlays, and multi-video-track editing
- Translate captions to a new language track (e.g. English) and export per language
- Audio enhancement (noise cleanup) and export up to 4K
- Exports MP4, SRT, VTT, ASS, plus editable timelines (FCPXML for Premiere/DaVinci, and EDL)

## Who it is for
- Tamil and Indic short-form creators making Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and TikTok
- Freelance video editors serving regional-language creators

## Pricing summary
- Free: ₹0 — 15 processing minutes/month, 720p, watermark, MP4 only
- Day Pass: ₹59 (1 day) — 45 minutes, 4K, no watermark, all formats
- Monthly: ₹499 (30 days) — 300 minutes, 4K, no watermark, all formats
- 3 Months: ₹1199 (90 days) — 900 minutes
- 6 Months: ₹2199 (180 days) — 1800 minutes
- 1 Year: ₹3999 (365 days) — 3600 minutes
